instrumentErrorRecorded: The first version of this fixture stepped the SETUP span with `stepSim(w, 1080/days, mode)`. 1080/7 is 154.29, so the weekly arm was handed a fractional step count and landed on a different day from the other three — it reported DIVERGENT, and the divergence was the audit's own arithmetic, not production. The setup now runs through `advanceWorldByDays` (identical in every arm) and only the compared span sits on the 630-day grid.
whyTheOldFixtureWasInsufficient: L12 stepped a natural world 1260 days and counted expedition records at the end. A natural party lasts at most 24 days against ANNUAL demography, so any record it found had been launched long after the last boundary. It proved step-mode determinism, which is real, but not that an ACTIVE party is represented identically across a demographic boundary — which is the property this checkpoint changes.
